comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
offroad.warn: Weh yuh a go?! Dis a bush track, not di road!
Brethren, yuh tek a wrong turn — dat nuh lead nowhere good!
Hold on — dis a mountain road, it soon done finish!
offroad.tyre: Yuh tyre bus pon di rockstone dem! Turn back!
Di rock-rock road lick yuh tyre — come off di mountain!
offroad.noroad: Road done finish! Nuttn up here but bush and mountain — turn back!
Yuh reach di dead end, brethren — no road from here!
offroad.return: Good — yuh find di real road again! Drive carefully!
Back pon di proper road! No more shortcuts up di mountain!
